evals.prompt: I just started a new FastAPI project and want to set up Claude Code hooks for it. Can you run the project-hook-setup skill to install hooks that will verify tests before marking complete, check health endpoints, and validate dependencies?
evals.expected_output: Project hooks installed in .claude/hooks/ with proper config in .claude/config/project.json. Hooks should include verify-tests.py, verify-health.py, require-dependencies.py, session-entry.sh, auto-load-orchestrator.sh, and verify-files-exist.py.

evals.prompt: I need to set up project hooks for my Node.js Express API project. The dev server runs on port 3000, health check is at /health, tests are run with 'npm test', and I need Redis running at localhost:6379. Run the hook setup in non-interactive mode.
evals.expected_output: Project hooks configured with Node.js/Express settings, port 3000, health check command, npm test command, and Redis service requirement.

evals.prompt: My .claude/hooks/ directory is missing and I need to reinstall the project hooks. I already have .claude/config/project.json configured. Run setup in non-interactive mode.
evals.expected_output: Hooks reinstalled from templates to .claude/hooks/ directory, all made executable, settings.json updated to reference them.
